items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I know him from Paris, and Emile was a regular guy, 'cause he was always with us... Emile would always be at the 'Flea Pit'. He was the only guy of Billy Arnold's band... that came around to see us, and stayed with us, and was with us.

ctx.x: Well, there was another American guy named, a trombonist named Emile Christian who was in Germany at that time; is that right?
